tax.heading: Income taxes
tax.text:
We are required to estimate our income taxes in each of the jurisdictions in which we operate. This process involves estimating our current tax exposure and assessing temporary differences resulting from differing treatment of items for tax and accounting purposes. These differences result in deferred tax assets and liabilities, which are included within our Consolidated Balance Sheets. We then assess the likelihood that our deferred tax assets will be recovered from future taxable income within the relevant jurisdiction. To the extent we believe that recovery is not likely, we must establish a valuation allowance. We provide valuation allowances for certain deferred tax assets where it is more likely than not that any portion will not be realized.

The application of tax laws and regulations to calculate our tax liabilities is subject to legal and factual interpretation, judgment and uncertainty in a multitude of jurisdictions. Tax laws and regulations themselves are subject to change as a result of changes in fiscal policy, changes in legislation, the evolution of regulations, including the federal statute controlling tax and spending policies enacted on July 4, 2025 (the “2025 Bill”), as well as court rulings.

net sales.text: We establish revenue reserves, primarily for product returns, price adjustments and stock rotations for products sold. Each revenue reserve requires the use of judgment and estimates that impact the amount and timing of revenue recognition. We record reductions of revenue for such reserve adjustments, in the same period that the related revenue is recorded. The reserves are estimated based on the expected value method derived from historical data, current expectations and economic conditions, and contractual terms with customers, including distributors. s.t: Sales to our resellers and distributors accounted for 47.6%, 32.3% and 29.3% of our revenue in fiscal years 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
One of our resellers accounted for 20.3%, 12.4%, and 11.3% of our revenue in fiscal years 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
A second reseller accounted for 14.3% and 11.2% of our revenue in fiscal year 2026 and 2025, respectively, but did not exceed 10% in fiscal year 2024.

For fiscal years 2026, 2025 and 2024, no direct customer individually accounted for 10% or more of our revenue and sales to our top 25 direct customers accounted for an aggregate of 35.8%, 45.6% and 47.0% of our revenue, respectively.

In the fiscal year ended October 2, 2026, no direct customers individually accounted for 10% or more of our revenue and sales to our top 10 direct and distribution customers accounted for an aggregate of 58.3% of our revenue.

Two of our resellers individually accounted for 20.3% and 14.3% of our revenue in fiscal year 2026, and our largest reseller represented approximately 29.0% of our accounts receivable as of October 2, 2026, which concentrates our credit risk.
Sales to customers located outside the U.S. accounted for 61.9% of our revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2, 2026.

Sales to customers located in China and the Asia Pacific region typically account for a large portion of our overall sales to customers located outside the U.S. For example, fiscal year 2026 sales to customers in China and the Asia Pacific region accounted for 37.7% and 11.6% of total fiscal year 2026 sales, respectively.
Sales to distributors accounted for approximately 47.6% of our revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2, 2026.
Sales to customers located in China, based on customer billing address, increased to 37.7% of our revenue in fiscal year 2026 from 28.4% in fiscal year 2025.

In fiscal year 2026, research and development expense increased by $41.4 million, or 16.9%, to $285.8 million, representing 21.5% of revenue, compared with $244.5 million, representing 25.3% of revenue, in fiscal year 2025.
(2) No country or region represented greater than 10% of our total revenue for the periods presented, other than the United States, China and the Asia Pacific region as presented above.
